# Summary

This article lists known applications of the R package `spatialRF` found in the literature.

*This page is maintained by hand and may be incomplete. If you've used `spatialRF` in a publication, talk, or blog post and would like it listed here, please open an issue at the [package repository](https://github.com/BlasBenito/spatialRF).
